scope: Official DfC/HED/OpenDataNI ArcGIS heritage and building-status sources for Belfast, focusing on rows not already exhausted by Belfast planning-statistics work and prior HARNI/Scheduled Zone packs.

source_audits.source_name: Historic Environment Division GIS Data FeatureServer
source_audits.publisher: Department for Communities Historic Environment Division
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: OpenDataNI/HED public GIS factual data is treated as public sector information under the UK Open Government Licence where applicable; images, logos, base maps and third-party content are excluded.
source_audits.coverage_years_checked: HED public GIS layers checked on 2026-05-19; service metadata reported current update published 2026-05-06 during this pass.
source_audits.update_frequency: Monthly according to HED service/OpenDataNI metadata.
source_audits.geographic_scope: Northern Ireland public HED GIS layers; Belfast rows scoped by layer Council/LGD/DC fields where present or by local Belfast boundary for point layers without LGD.
source_audits.key_fields_used: Layer metadata, row OBJECTID/reference fields, date_visited, INSERTDATE, UPDATEDATE, Date_Added, Date_added, current grade/status fields and geometries.
source_audits.reliability: strong for official register/source rows; usable with caveats for city-change candidate events
source_audits.required_caveats: The service is an authoritative public snapshot for HED map-viewer use, not a legal declaration document or physical-works observation. Preserve accessed_at and row URL for review.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use only rows with defensible row-level source dates/status observations. Keep legal/admin/source-maintenance caveats attached to every event.

source_audits.coverage_years_checked: Belfast-scoped Defence Heritage rows with date_visited from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19.
source_audits.update_frequency: HED GIS service is monthly; DfC describes the Defence Heritage Record survey project as 2020-2024 with records available through the map viewer.

source_audits.reliability: strong for official defence-heritage register/condition observations; usable with caveats for city-change events

source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Recommended as Belfast heritage/building-status tail candidates with explicit source-observation caveats and row-level OBJECTID/DHR provenance.

source_audits.publisher: Department for Communities Historic Environment Division

source_audits.coverage_years_checked: Belfast-scoped Industrial Heritage rows with INSERTDATE or UPDATEDATE from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19.
source_audits.update_frequency: HED GIS service is monthly; DfC notes the Industrial Heritage Record is largely a record of industry-related sites compiled from historic maps and survey sources.
source_audits.geographic_scope: Belfast point records selected from Industrial Heritage Records by point-in-local-Belfast-boundary because the layer does not expose LGD/Council fields.
